pages.title: Brewing
pages.text: The $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/brewing)Small Cauldron$(/l) chapter teaches the brewing method and lists each ingredient combination. These pages record what each finished brew does.

pages.title: On Brews
pages.text: Brews provide powerful but often balanced effects. Most last for a moderate duration, which can be extended when wearing the Moonweave set.

pages.title: Brew of Bloodlust
pages.text: Grants Bloodlust, allowing you to heal from damage dealt while preventing natural regeneration.

pages.title: Brew of Spikeskin
pages.text: Increases armor and reflects a portion of incoming damage, at the cost of reduced movement speed.

pages.title: Brew of Slimewalker
pages.text: Negates fall damage and enables bouncing movement, while slowing movement when grounded.

pages.title: Brew of Homestead
pages.text: Returns you to your bound location upon use. The effect is disorienting and is not affected by duration bonuses.

pages.title: Brew of Siphon
pages.text: Increases mining speed and pulls nearby items toward you, while increasing exhaustion as you mine.

pages.title: Brew of Daybloom
pages.text: Grants regeneration and speed in daylight, but becomes harmful in low light conditions.

pages.title: Brew of Arachnid Grace
pages.text: Allows wall climbing, removes poison, and enables free movement through cobwebs, but weakens you in water.

pages.title: Brew of Gravebloom
pages.text: While its blessing lasts, monsters you slay may leave a small mossy patch where they fall, with fresh herbs and other plants rising from it.

pages.title: Brew of Hollow Silence
pages.text: Silences your presence near sound-sensitive entities such as the Warden, while occasionally applying darkness.

pages.title: On Discovery
pages.text: Brews are best discovered through experimentation. Use recipe viewers for exact ingredient combinations.
